name: Kanzaki (Saga, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kanzaki city emblem in green, blue and red: green and blue curved strokes like a river, with a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Kanzaki, a city in Saga Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 March 2006.

features.role: Kanzaki city emblem — green and blue curved strokes like a river, with a red disc
